# NEW 2026-11-17 theme-rework UI-2: found all themes at once, opening choice, move a theme's administrative seat.
# Generated by gen_theme_setup.py; edit the generator and regenerate instead of editing by hand.
on_game_started_after_lobby = { on_actions = { oe_theme_setup_startup } }

oe_theme_setup_startup = {
    trigger = { current_year >= 1200 }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_start_is_1337 = yes
                current_year >= 1337
                current_year < 1340
            }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:BYT01 c:BYT01 = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
                c:BYT01 = { oe_theme_admin_init = yes }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_ai = no } }
                c:BYZ = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_theme_setup.1 }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
                c:BYZ = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_found_all_count value = 0 }
                    oe_theme_found_streamlined = yes
                    remove_variable = oe_theme_found_all_count
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
                current_year = 1453
                country_exists = c:BYZ
            }
            oe_byz_1453_bootstrap_core_ios = yes
            if = {
                limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                c:BYZ = { oe_byz_1453_found_morea_theme = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
